item.title: PVC — A Role-Based UI Construction Architecture
item.description: The complete PVC documentation set: five architectural roles (Page, View, Component, Decoration/Aligner, UI Element) distinct from any framework, project structure, State vs Condition, View & Rendition, the three placement poles, Wrapper Components, the Settled-Behavior Axiom, and Specialised Components.
